name: generate-unit-tests
description: Add focused xUnit characterisation or unit tests without prematurely changing legacy behaviour.
---
# Generate unit tests

Inspect source and nearby tests. Confirm the behaviour to capture and label it as observation or approved requirement. Add the smallest deterministic xUnit test, with a meaningful name, clear arrange/act/assert, explicit data, and negative/boundary values where valuable. Avoid over-mocking and implementation detail. For seeded defects, run the test before proposing a fix. Update traceability and report the exact test command/result.
